title: ddRAD-Seq Protocol
author: Lara Shepherd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zgyf3xw
materials: Pool ligations for each index. Purify each index pool with a Qiaquick PCR purification kit (Qiagen), following the manufacturer’s instructions except elute in 35 µl of Buffer EB and leave on the column for 1 min prior to centrifugation. Leave the final elution in an open 1.7ml tubes on a heating block set at 40˚C for 20 min to ensure no EtOH is present.

For the size range that will be processed, weigh the gel slice and subtract the weight of the tube. Process each index by putting it through a Qiaquick gel extraction kit (Qiagen), following manufacture’s instructions except use 30 µl buffer EB for the final elution and leave the elution buffer on the column for 4 min prior to centrifugation.
Quantify each index with a Qubit dsDNA HS (high sensitivity) assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific), following manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify one PCR of each index with a Qubit dsDNA HS (high sensitivity) assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to confirm that DNA concentration has increased with the PCR.
Combine the PCRs for each index and purify with a MinElute kit (Qiagen), eluting in 12 µl Buffer EB.
Quantify each index with a Qubit dsDNA HS (high sensitivity) assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Combine each index equimolar.

steps.title: Digest DNA with AvaII and MspI
steps.instruction: Set up a 30 µl digestion containing 300 ng DNA, AvaII and MspI (New England Biolabs). Incubate at 37 °C for 3 h in a PCR machine, then inactivate enzymes at 65 °C for 20 min. Verify complete digestion by electrophoresing 4 µl of the reaction on a 2 % agarose gel.

steps.title: Ligate adaptors to digested DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare a 40 µl ligation using T4 DNA ligase (New England Biolabs) with the digested DNA. Incubate at 23 °C for 2 h in a PCR machine, then inactivate the ligase at 65 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Test ligation via PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Set up 12 µl PCR reactions containing 1× MyTaq buffer (Bioline, Australia), 5 pmol each of primer P2.2‑Msp and the unique forward adaptor primer, and ligated DNA. Thermocycle: 94 °C 2 min; 30 cycles of 94 °C 20 s, 55 °C 20 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min. Load 5 µl of the PCR product alongside unamplified ligated DNA on a 2 % agarose gel to confirm amplification.

steps.title: Prepare and run gel for pooled indices
steps.instruction: Clean the gel apparatus with 70 % ethanol. Assemble a gel with 2 % agarose using fresh running buffer. Tape adjacent wells together to create wide wells for each pooled index, leaving an empty well between indices and placing a DNA ladder at both ends. Load each pooled index into its single well, then run the gel at 80 V for 80 min.

steps.title: Excise size‑selected fragments from gel
steps.instruction: Label 1.7 ml tubes with the index and the desired size range (e.g., 300‑500 bp, 500‑700 bp). Using a fresh razor blade for each index, cut out the appropriate gel slices, minimizing UV exposure. Store excess slices at –20 °C as backups.

steps.title: Amplify indexed fragments with Illumina adapters
steps.instruction: For each index, perform 4–6 PCRs in 20 µl volumes using 1× Phusion Flash High‑Fidelity PCR Master Mix (Thermo Scientific), 4 pmol each of primer PCR1 and a unique PCR‑Index primer, and 5 µl of the gel‑extracted ligation product.
